title: Chapter 175 Han Fei
content:
Chapter 175 Han Fei

Xinzheng, the General's Mansion.

"General, it's a special period recently. King Jing of the Royal Kingdom has come to Xinzheng. Then, should we continue with the long-planned ghost soldier robbery?" Mo Ya, the tall and straight bird leader dressed in black, turned towards Ji Wuye asked.

"Ghost soldiers robbing wages... Of course, we must continue. For this plan, I have been planning for nearly half a year, and I have spent countless efforts. How can I just give up? This is a military salary of 100,000 taels!" Ji Wuye said first. He pondered for a while, then said with a resolute expression on his face.

"Yes, then this subordinate will go to prepare now. It will be time to start the plan in ten days!" Seeing that his master had already spoken, Mo Crow nodded tactfully, and did not intend to intervene to persuade him. In Ji Wuye's eyes, he was just a humble servant.

"Well, you go, be careful, if there is a mistake, you should understand..." With a soft snort, Ji Wuye let Mo Crow back down.

...

On the outskirts of Xinzheng, there was heavy rain. The dry trees in the outskirts seemed to be a little more novel under the nourishment of the raindrops.

With the sound of horseshoes, a man in purple robe looked at the deserted city walls in the suburbs, his eyes were deep and his face was solemn.

"I'm back, people who want to see me, or don't want to see me, finally have to meet!" After the man said this, he pulled the rein of the horse, and the horse neighed and ran towards the city wall.

...

The wind is high and the clouds are broad, and the sky is clear.

The rising sun washed away the haze of yesterday, and the damp and depressing weather disappeared without a trace under the sunlight.

The noisy Xinzheng City continues to be prosperous in the past, and the endless flow of people seems to never see the moment when it stops. Looking from a high place, there are thousands of houses and thousands of tiles, black and black crowds, and there is no end in sight.

"Brother!" A beautiful and melodious female voice came, bringing a bit of coolness to the restless street.

Walking on the street, the man in purple robe who was looking around heard this familiar voice, seemed to understand something, and looked back.

"Red lotus!" The purple-robed man was surprised.

"You're finally back!" Princess Honglian, who was dressed in a pink dress, looked at the purple-robed man with joy on her face.

"Brother, miss me!" After staring at the purple-robed man, Princess Honglian rushed over, hugged him, and hung on his body.

Seeing this, everyone on the street already understood that this purple-robed man was naturally Han Fei, a Korean son who had been away from home for a long time and went to the shore of Sanghai in Qi to study.

"Wow, you miss me so much, why don't you kiss me!" Han Fei also had a smile on his face, stretched out his face to his closest sister, and joked at Honglian.

"Yes!" With a chuckle, Honglian ignored the crowds on the street and kissed Han Fei twice on the face.

"Fool, I'm joking!" Han Fei was really taken aback, and quickly blamed Honglian.

...

In Xinzheng City's Prince Yu Jing's mansion, in a small pavilion, Zhong Yu was making tea and discussing the Tao with several of his courtiers!

"Have you heard? Today, the ninth son of South Korea, Han Fei has returned to China!" Zhong Yu sat in his seat, and these words suddenly came out of his mouth.

"Han Fei, is that what His Majesty said before, this unrivaled genius who enjoys a high reputation in history?" Zhao Yun has some doubts about the Ninth Prince of South Korea that His Majesty mentioned, because as far as he knows, in his In this world, that Han Fei is not King Han's son.

"That's right, it's this Han Fei. The world is different. Even though its development trajectory is roughly the same, the subtleties still have their own differences and characteristics. Don't be surprised!" He answered Zhao Yun's question first, and then seemed Seeing his question, Zhong Yu began to explain.

"Your Majesty once said that he is from South Korea. Although most of the reasons are because he wants to ally with South Korea and block Qin Guodong's way out of the Kanto, part of it is because of Han Fei. Apart from resourcefulness, does this Han Fei have other special features? where?" Zhao Yun expressed his doubts.

Those who are wise and resourceful do not lack their own kingdoms. There are so many famous generals in the Three Kingdoms period. Even though they are not as good as these ancient sages of the Warring States period, they are not far behind.

"That's right, to make suggestions and govern the country, our country has a talent like the Qing Dynasty, so naturally we don't need such a Han Fei on purpose." Zhong Yu didn't answer Zhao Yun's question directly.

"Then what is your majesty doing?" Zhao Yun asked.

"Why? I also don't understand, maybe it's because of my interest, I suddenly thought about it!" Regarding this question, Zhong Yu himself is not very clear, and he doesn't want to figure it out. If everything is too clear, it will be meaningless .

"Yes, it's the subject who made too much of a slip of the tongue!" Hearing Zhong Yu's reply, Zhao Yun's face changed a little, realizing that he had lost his status as a subject.

...

A few days later, there was no major change in this bustling city because of the return of an extra Jiu Gongzi.

On the contrary, the famous brothels in the city, high-ranking officials and nobles, powerful and wealthy businessmen often haunt, and Zilanxuan, which lingers in it, has a regular visitor, which is a bit more fun.

"So, just a few days before I came, South Korea suddenly had a so-called King Jing, which touched the hearts of everyone in South Korea!" Leaning on his sleeper, with his hands on the armrest, Han Fei said lazily.

"Yeah, since Prince Jing came, my Zilanxuan's business has declined a lot. All the high-ranking officials and nobles stayed at home and acted as an upright gentleman. I really hope that you will leave a good impression on Prince Jing!" Zi Nu's charming voice rang in Han Fei's ears.

"Really? In that case, I am also an important customer of Zilanxuan now! Then you have to take good care of me, otherwise, be careful if I don't come, you will be completely left out here!" Hearing this Zinu's voice Explaining, Han Fei also had a playful face, joking.

"Of course, you are the noble son of South Korea. I dare not neglect you in this small place of love and moon. No, I, the boss of Zilanxuan, came to accompany you in person. Isn't it sincere enough?" Zi Nu chuckled, and continued following Han Fei's wishes.

"I also saw the sincerity of Miss Zi Nu, so she must come here every day, lingering, and even reluctant to go home!" Han Fei smiled. For the woman in front of him, she always felt that she was very mysterious and seemed to understand himself very well. thought.

"It seems that South Korea has become different again. It is a complete farewell to the lifeless calm of the past!" Looking at Zi Nu, Han Fei said these inexplicable words.
